stages.event: You enter the Graveyard. The air is eerie and filled with an unsettling feeling.

choices.1: Your ATT is high and you can easily defend yourself, proceed.
choices.2: You notice something shiny on the ground, can you pick it up?
choices.3: Your ENE is low, do you feel weak?

stages.event: You look around and notice that the Graveyard is filled with old, crumbling tombs and mausoleums.

choices.1: You feel threatened by the surroundings, do you defend yourself?
choices.2: You're curious about the history of the Graveyard, can you learn more?
choices.3: Your HAP is high, you feel at peace.

stages.event: A Ghost blocks your path! Can you scare it away?

choices.1: Use your high ATT to scare the Ghost away.
choices.2: Try to intimidate the Ghost with your high DEX.
choices.3: Show the Ghost your energy reserves to calm it down.

stages.event: The Zombie charges at you! Can you dodge?

choices.1: Quickly defend yourself with your high DEF.
choices.2: Try to outmaneuver the Zombie with your high DEX.
choices.3: Use your high ENE to boost your speed.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You stumble upon a pedestal with a mysterious object on top of it.

choices.1: Examine the object closely, can you figure out what it is?
choices.2: Try to pick up the object, can you move it?
choices.3: Use your high INT to analyze the object.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You come across a mysterious chest in the distance. It looks abandoned.

choices.1: Open the chest and claim your loot.
choices.2: Try to find a hidden mechanism to open the chest.
choices.3: Use your high HAP to sense if the chest contains anything valuable.

stages.event: You've completed your journey through the Graveyard. It's time to leave.

choices.1: Head back home, you've had enough of the Graveyard.
choices.2: Explore other areas of the Graveyard, there might be more to find.
choices.3: Return to your pet supplies and restock.
